title: How the visual-artifact renderer works
description: An agent writes JSON. A CLI checks and stores it. A Next.js page draws it with trusted components.

props.content: The agent never writes UI code. It writes a JSON spec made of node types. The CLI rejects anything outside the contract, saves the rest as a file, and a renderer maps each node to a component that is already trusted. That one rule keeps pages consistent and safe.

props.title: Open risks first
props.deck: These come from AGENTS.md, ARCHITECTURE.md and the recent log (latest tag v0.9.0, installed CLI 0.10.1).

props.title: From agent to browser
props.deck: Validation happens before anything touches the disk.

props.caption: The CLI is the gate: a bad spec never reaches the store, and the renderer parses the JSON again on load.
steps: note over cli: validate with the shared Zod schema
app -> store : fetch JSON in the browser
note over app, store: renderer parses again, maps nodes to adapters

props.content:
**Pi extension.** A thin wrapper in `pi-extension/visual-artifact.ts`. It also registers `choose_visual_artifact_direction`, `/visual-diff` and `/visual-recap`.

**CLI.** A Bun binary in `cli/`: `create`, `validate`, `serve`, `list`, `open`, `doctor`, `bootstrap`.

**Store.** `~/.agents/skills/visual-artifact/artifacts/<project>/<slug>/` holds `artifact.json` and `annotations.json`.

props.title: Inside the renderer
props.deck: Four steps from JSON to a page.

props.code:
flowchart LR url["/project/slug
static shell"] loader["Client loader
fetches artifact.json"] zod["Zod parse
VisualArtifactSpec"] reg["Component registry
type to adapter"] ad["Adapters
app/src/components/adapters"] url --> loader loader --> zod zod --> reg reg --> ad
props.caption: The registry is the only place that knows which adapter draws which node type.

props.title: Two ports, two jobs
props.deck: The split exists because one server has hot reload and one is a built snapshot.

props.caption: New artifacts appear on 9998 without a rebuild because the static export holds only the shell.

props.title: Run each server
props.code:
cd app && pnpm dev                    # :9999, HMR
cd cli && bun run src/main.ts serve --no-open   # :9998, static preview

props.title: Source of truth
props.code:
shared/src/contract.ts          node manifest for the LLM
shared/src/artifact-schema.ts   executable Zod schema
app/src/lib/contract/*          re-exports for the renderer
cli/assets/contract.json        generated by pnpm export:contract
pi-extension/visual-artifact.ts thin tool wrapper
